name: Question 6
problem:
Consider the following partitions:

- ${P}_{1}={{x}_{0},{x}_{1},…,{x}_{m}}$ is a partition of the interval $[-1,1]$

- ${P}_{2}={{y}_{0},{y}_{1},…,{y}_{n}}$ is a partition of the interval $[-1,1]$

Calculate ${\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}10({y}_{j}+{y}_{j-1})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j},$ where $Δ{x}_{i}={x}_{i}-{x}_{i-1}$ and $Δ{y}_{j}={y}_{j}-{y}_{j-1}.$

html:
Question 6
?

Consider the following partitions:

  • P1={x0,x1,…,xm} is a partition of the interval [−1,1]

  • P2={y0,y1,…,yn} is a partition of the interval [−1,1]

Calculate ∑i=1m∑j=1n10(yj+yj−1)ΔxiΔyj, where Δxi=xi−xi−1 and Δyj=yj−yj−1.

a
−10
b
20
c
40
d
−20
e
0
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Using the constant multiple and product rules, we can write the summation as

10∑i=1mΔxi⋅∑j=1n(yj+yj−1)Δyj.

Note that ∑i=1mΔxi is just the length of the interval [−1,1]. So, we have

∑i=1mΔxi=1−(−1)=2.

For the sum over j, we evaluate it as follows:

∑j=1n(yj+yj−1)Δyj=(y1+y0)Δy1+(y2+y1)Δy2+⋯+(yn+xn−1)Δyn=(y1+y0)(y1−y0)+(y2+y1)(y2−y1)+⋯+(yn+yn−1)(yn−yn−1)=(y12−y02)+(y22−y12)+⋯+(yn2−yn−12)=(y12−y02)+(y22−y12)+⋯+(yn2−yn−12)=−y02+yn2=yn2−y02=12−(−1)2=0 Combining our results, we finally arrive at

10∑i=1mΔxi⋅∑j=1n(yj+yj−1)Δyj.=10⋅2⋅0=0.
